not_implied.what: two lm_head chunks are not a K/V edge
not_implied.why: the head chunk performs no attention and commits no K/V boundary, so there is no cache to hand over: its input is its own block's residual, bound on the layer axis, and its output is its own block's ids, bound by the emitted -> consumed check

unchecked_ends.why: root_ok compares the proof's commitment 0 against its own statement's pre_root; that the root is the model's, for this layer and this shape, is the verifier's declaration

unchecked_ends.what: which model each chunk's shape root is
unchecked_ends.why: no --expect-pre-roots table was given, so every chunk's pre_root is compared only against its own proof; `zk-prover model-roots --plan PLAN` derives the table from the model

unchecked_ends.what: the model each chunk proves against
unchecked_ends.why: no --expect-model-roots manifest was given, so every chunk's model_root is compared only against its own proof; `zk-prover model-roots --plan PLAN` publishes the manifest from the weights
